title: Claude Code UserPromptSubmit hook output
description: JSON a UserPromptSubmit hook prints on stdout (exit 0). Can block the submitted prompt, or inject context alongside it.

decision.description: Optional. Blocks prompt processing and erases the prompt from context. Omit to let the prompt through.

reason.description: Shown to the user when 'decision' is block; not added to context. Required when blocking.

hookEventName.description: Discriminator; must match the firing event.

additionalContext.description: Optional context added alongside the submitted prompt.

suppressOriginalPrompt.description: When true and 'decision' is block, omits the original prompt text from the block message.

continue.description: If false, Claude stops processing entirely after the hook runs. Overrides any event-specific decision.

stopReason.description: Message shown to the user when 'continue' is false. Not shown to Claude.

suppressOutput.description: If true, hides the hook's stdout from the transcript.

systemMessage.description: Warning message shown to the user.

terminalSequence.description: Terminal escape sequence Claude Code emits for the hook (OSC 0/1/2/9/99/777 and BEL only; anything else is ignored). Requires Claude Code v2.1.141+.
